items.title: 让开关自我消亡：AI 赋能的 Feature Flag 全生命周期治理
items.raw_excerpt: 随着微服务与敏捷迭代的深化，功能开关已成为现代软件交付不可或缺的风险控制手段。但在快手这样业务高度复杂、迭代极其迅猛的超大规模系统中，大量长期存活的开关正在演变为一种沉重的隐性技术债。本文整理自快手资深服务端架构师 闫文亮 在 QCon 全球软件开发大会 2026 北京站 的分享《让开关自我消亡：AI 赋能的 Feature Flag 全生命周期治理》。他在分享中对 AI 赋能开关全生命周期治理的完整实践进行了复盘，内容涵盖从治理困局、AI Agent 的工程落地，到双引擎安全护栏、自进化机制，以及 AI Native 治理范式的演进全过程。

title_i18n.zh: 让开关自我消亡：AI 赋能的 Feature Flag 全生命周期治理

title_i18n.es: Dejar que los interruptores desaparezcan por sí mismos: Gestión del ciclo de vida completo de Feature Flags impulsada por IA

excerpt_i18n.zh: 随着微服务与敏捷迭代的深化，功能开关已成为现代软件交付不可或缺的风险控制手段。但在快手这样业务高度复杂、迭代极其迅猛的超大规模系统中，大量长期存活的开关正在演变为一种沉重的隐性技术债。本文整理自快手资深服务端架构师 闫文亮 在 QCon 全球软件开发大会 2026 北京站 的分享《让开关自我消亡：AI 赋能的 Feature Flag 全生命周期治理》。他在分享中对 AI 赋能开关全生命周期治理的完整实践进行了复盘，内容涵盖从治理困局、AI Agent 的工程落地，到双引擎安全护栏、自进化机制，以及 AI Native 治理范式的演进全过程。
excerpt_i18n.en: As microservices and agile iteration deepen, feature flags have become an indispensable risk control tool in modern software delivery. However, in a hyper-scale system like Kuaishou, where business complexity is high and iteration is extremely rapid, a large number of long-lived flags are evolving into a heavy form of hidden technical debt. This article is based on the presentation "Let Feature Flags Die on Their Own: AI-Empowered Full Lifecycle Governance of Feature Flags" by Yan Wenliang, Senior Server-Side Architect at Kuaishou, at QCon Global Software Development Conference 2026 Beijing. In his talk, he reviewed the complete practice of AI-empowered full lifecycle governance of feature flags, covering everything from governance challenges and the engineering implementation of AI Agents, to dual-engine safety guardrails, self-evolution mechanisms, and the evolution of the AI-native governance paradigm.
excerpt_i18n.es: Con la profundización de los microservicios y la iteración ágil, los interruptores de funcionalidades se han convertido en un medio indispensable de control de riesgos en la entrega de software moderno. Sin embargo, en sistemas de escala masiva como los de Kuaishou, donde el negocio es extremadamente complejo y las iteraciones son muy rápidas, una gran cantidad de interruptores de larga duración se están transformando en una pesada deuda técnica oculta. Este artículo está basado en la presentación "Haz que los interruptores desaparezcan por sí solos: Gestión del ciclo de vida completo de Feature Flags impulsada por IA" de Yan Wenliang, arquitecto senior de servidores de Kuaishou, en la Conferencia Global de Desarrollo de Software QCon 2026 en Pekín. items.title: How to Think About AI Before It's Too Late
items.raw_excerpt: Cory Doctorow has a refrain: “The most important thing about a gadget isn’t what it does; it’s who it does it for and what it does it to.” In this episode of Galaxy Brain , he sits down with Charlie Warzel to talk about the AI boom, making the case that the hype, vision, and dreams of endless growth are unsustainable. Doctorow expands on his viral “enshittification” thesis: a critique of AI based around power and whether we are using AI tools or being used by them.

items.raw_excerpt: Hot tubs sit at about 38 to 40 degrees Celsius, warm enough that most people can only soak for about 15 minutes. NVIDIA’s newest AI servers can run their cooling liquid even hotter — up to 45 degrees Celsius, or 113 degrees Fahrenheit. That higher temperature limit is precisely what makes them more energy efficient. […]

title_i18n.en: Hotter Than a Hot Tub: The 45°C Breakthrough to Cool AI’s Biggest Machines
title_i18n.zh: 比热水浴缸还热：45°C突破为AI最大型机器降温
title_i18n.es: Más caliente que un jacuzzi: el avance de 45 °C para enfriar las máquinas más grandes de la IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Hot tubs sit at about 38 to 40 degrees Celsius, warm enough that most people can only soak for about 15 minutes. NVIDIA’s newest AI servers can run their cooling liquid even hotter — up to 45 degrees Celsius, or 113 degrees Fahrenheit. That higher temperature limit is precisely what makes them more energy efficient. […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: 热水浴缸的温度通常在38到40摄氏度之间，大多数人只能泡大约15分钟。而英伟达最新的人工智能服务器能让冷却液运行在更高温度——高达45摄氏度，即113华氏度。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los jacuzzis se mantienen a unos 38 a 40 grados Celsius, lo suficientemente calientes como para que la mayoría de las personas solo puedan sumergirse unos 15 minutos. Los servidores de inteligencia artificial más nuevos de NVIDIA pueden hacer funcionar su líquido refrigerante a temperaturas aún más altas, hasta 45 grados Celsius, o 113 grados Fahrenheit.

items.title: AI 太烧钱！微软选择「倒戈」DeepSeek
items.raw_excerpt: Claude、GPT 不再独占 Copilot。     作者丨 樊天骄、郑佳美     编辑丨 郑佳美                                                                                                         这两天，微软连续释放了两条重磅消息。 第一条来自产品层面。微软宣布 Copilot Cowork 在全球正式上线。这款能够跨 Outlook、Teams、Excel 等应用自主执行任务的 AI Agent 系统将正式商用。据微软披露，超过一半的《财富》500 强企业已经在预览期进行了部署。 第二条则来自商业模式层面。Copilot Cowork 将不再完全沿用每月 30 美元的固定订阅模式，而是开始引入按使用量计费机制。 几乎在同一时间，Axios 又披露了一则消息：微软正评估将 DeepSeek V4 引入 Copilot Cowork，作为低成本模型选项。如果最终落地，这将成为美国大型科技公司首次在核心企业级 AI 产品中引入中国大模型。 这两条消息似乎释放出一个信号，即Agent 的普及正在让 AI

title_i18n.en: The Atlantic created a searchable database of the music used to train AI
title_i18n.zh: 《大西洋月刊》创建了一个可搜索的数据库，收录了用于训练人工智能的音乐。
title_i18n.es: El Atlántico creó una base de datos consultable de la música utilizada para entrenar IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: Atlantic reporter Alex Reisner recently uncovered four datasets of music being used to train AI models and made them fully searchable for the public. Two of the sets are absolutely enormous at 12 million and 9 million tracks. The other two are much smaller, but still represent a significant amount of training data at over […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: 大西洋月刊记者亚历克斯·赖斯纳近期发现了四组用于训练AI模型的音乐数据集，并向公众开放了完整搜索功能。其中两组数据集的规模极为庞大，分别包含1200万条和900万条音轨。
excerpt_i18n.es: El reportero de The Atlantic Alex Reisner descubrió recientemente cuatro conjuntos de datos musicales utilizados para entrenar modelos de inteligencia artificial y los hizo totalmente buscables para el público. Dos de los conjuntos son absolutamente enormes, con 12 millones y 9 millones de canciones.
